source_requirement: The system shall ensure that a secure and effective interface is established to reduce the affiliated risk of errors from inaccurate data formats.
The system shall allow user validation to be done during login to ensure that the user is who they claim to be
The data provided by the system should be validated and verified were possible.
The results from the scanning process must be reliable, which means minimum or no false positives
domains: payroll and human resources management system

source_requirement: The system shall apply a mechanism to establish proof of identities, to verify who a particular user is.
The system should be able to match fingerprint at login.
The system shall allow the user to sign a document
The system shall be able to enable payment which will have 2 factor authentication (static password and OTP)
The system shall be able to authenticate users so that any unauthorized persons should not be granted by the system
The system shall not be vulnerable to the security attacks
When packets come in through the NIC, the system should be able to detect traffic out of the norm.
The system shall allow the user to check for data integrity using MD5 hash algorithm
